I don't know what to say, playing this for the first time in 2024, when I got this game for 4.99$ - looks like a steal for me. The campaign is like a whole movie in the star wars series! In fact this game is being a reskin for battlefield games, SW Battlefront is a must have addition to your steam library if you are either a SW fan or Battlefield fan, the game have the best of 2 worlds believe me, you will not regret it. I heard that upon release the game was spoiled with microtransactions - now you have all the heroes open for free. So give it a try, you will not regret it!

At the current state of the game, I wouldn't recommend purchasing Battlefront 2.
Not that the game is bad when it comes to gameplay or graphics. This is one of my favorites.
My issue is that hackers and annoying glitches are infesting almost EVERY lobby you join. Supremacy? chuds spam in chat about "no lobby will be spared" then mass kill the enemy team (or yours if you're unlucky enough.) Okay, let's try Ewok Hunt. Impossible for Stormtroopers to win because the shuttle arriving animation bugs all player cameras. That's fine. Let's see if Galactic Assault works. Annoying bug/hack where all player cameras are fixed in one spot. The only mode "genre" that actually works as intended is Heroes and Villains, and half the time the players of that mode are straight assholes.
The only game that captures true heart and soul of the battles in Star wars

What a surprise this game is, accidently found it, played it, then decided to buy a steam license because it's that good.
And it's so damn re-playable, I love it.

The wife bought me this to play with friends but after a few days they got bored.
The last thousand or so players have been chugging along on this for years so the skill gap is rather daunting.

Regardless I carried on, and after far tooooo long learning how to fly spaceships and fight as a jedi in a First Person Shooter I finally 100%'d it.

Its pretty, its wonderful to see a game I played on ps2 way back when in modern graphics, and the sound effects... ooo the sound effects... the pew pew of blasters, the whooooommmm of lightsabers... glorious!

The gameplay is solid, as you may have gathered by my comment about spaceships I didn't like that part. But after sticking it out I got pretty ok at it!

The worst part is EA being EA left this to die, hackers are rife, bugs that mean you can move and shoot but you can't see your character at all, camera is stuck in a tree or some shit... and there was a bug where your inventory wouldn't load so you couldn't gain EXP.... it took them 3 or 4 DAYS to fix this!!!!! It effected everyone on every system and it took them ~4 days to sort the shite out... insane.

Game gets a 7/10 all in all. EA get 1/10.

Far too many hackers and there is zero effective anti-cheat. It's common enough that I can see how sophisticated the cheats are now. They are able to impersonate game admins in chat, one-shot players, toggle aimbots, you name it. The game is abandoned. "deadgamelol" is more than a meme for SWBF2.

Because this is actually running in Origin you aren't able to report someone through steam. Most of the game-modes can't even get enough players to start them as it requires a minimum amount of people to start. The four-player Co-Op against NPCs is fun, but you'll get bored of it quick.

This game is absolutely amazing, the graphics are stunning and the game runs extremely well and smooth, it's optimized fully. The campaign is decent with dramatic scenes and engaging gameplay but what this game shines most at is the multiplayer. It doesn't matter if you're a fan or Star War or not, the multiplayer is just amazing as it has a wide selection of iconic heroes and villains and cool powers. The locations are brilliant too and the variety of modes you can choose to play is excellent.

This game has a excellent story mode and a really fun Multiplayer mode. Tons of Classic Characters from the Star Wars Trilogy to chose who each have their own level system in which you would need to level up your Heros and Troops to unlock and upgrade certain abilities, weapons and attachments. This system brings one downside, a majority of the time you will go against players with higher levels and tons of upgraded abilities. Luckily there isn't just online PvP you can play offline Co-op with 3 other players to upgrade characters and abilities and make them better for Multiplayer use.
There's tons to do in this game from flying X-wings in space to playing as a Jedi having light saber battles with other players..
All around this game has great graphics, a great story mode and great game play. You can play this game competitively or casually and easily play with friends. Must buy game if you're a fan of Star Wars.

Although Battlefront 2 had quite a rocky launch, the game is now incredibly enjoyable. I have played since launch and EA has, in my opinion, redeemed themselves. The single-player campaign could have been longer, but you shouldn't buy this for the campaign anyway.

The Star Wars: Squadrons trailer got me drooling, hopefully EA won't disappoint.

Just finished the main campaign and my review does not consider multiplayer at all:
Simply put, graphics still look great and the star wars world is still powerful enough to make you interested. However, besides some beautiful set pieces there is nothing compeling about the main characters or the story and the AI is absolutely terrible. Its like someone programmed the most generic AI possible and threw enemies in the map with no consideration whatsoever. There is no strategy, no clever play, no battle puzzle pieces (like characters with different abilities that require you to prioritize them or play around their skill) nothing. Just a bunch of mindless push-forward lunatics. Therefore, if you are a Star Wars fan and it is on -85% sale it might be worth it, since just living in this world and seeing classic characters might make it worthwhile. Otherwise, dont waste your time.

Actually good now that the lootboxes are gone, the game feels like a direct and worthy successor to BF2 2005. A little on the tedious (In the same vein as the grind of CoD or Battlefield) side, but by all means a stellar (no pun intended) game and is well worth the 12 bucks I paid for it on sale.

Campaign is fun, good writing and isn't too hamfisted with "nostalgia wank" but does kinda shoehorn some characters in, but much more delicately than is the norm for this sort of thing. The stealth sections are annoying but you can always just shoot everyone, except during the prologue where you control a droid. At time of writing, I have not finished the campaign but thus far it's good.

Multiplayer is kinda deadish when playing off-hours, which is by no means an issue, just don't play at 4 AM. The most popular mode from my experience is Clone Wars Supremacy on Kamino. Mileage may vary.

Buy it on sale, and go burn some holes in the clankers.

I will start recommending EA games under ONE condition:

!! ADD STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS EA !!
Indie game companies can do it, so should you. You basically opened a portal to Steam, and that's it. Implementing mandatory installation/use of Origin was also a d*ck move.

Some people are even saying that they'll re-purchase their entire Origin library if you add steam achievements. You like your money EA. There's another opportunity to be had.

Let me put it another way. Currently, I only own a few EA games.
- SW Jedi Fallen Order
- SW Battlefront II

If steam achievements were implemented, this list would look more like this:
- SW Jedi Fallen Order
- SW Battlefront II
- SW Squadrons (I would even preorder)
- Dead Space 1/2/3
- Dragon Age Origins/2/Inquisition
- Titanfall 2
- Burnout Paradise Remastered
- NFS Heat/Rivals/Hot Pursuit
- Mass Effect 1/2/Andromeda
- Crysis 1/2/3

That's 20 titles right there, by a man who has hated EA for their microtransaction/lootbox controversy and slew of slimy marketing tactics.

See my point yet?

This game came a long way, and although the shame of it's initial launch and micro-transactions should not be forgotten easily (lest EA repeat their poor behavior) as it stands now, this is everything a Star Wars game ought to be. In spite of my own review, this Battlefront II is right up there with the classic Battlefront II.

Great 9/10 game ruined by hackers. 80% of lobbies I join have a hacking problem. I live in California, and you'd think there'd be enough lobbies, but no, on a Sunday I can't get anything without hackers. It's almost impossible to play anymore.

Disgustingly terrible flight control. Idiotic to non existent NPC actions. Distorted body view that is so bad, they have a setting you can toggle to make it worse or just really bad. Cut scenes have both really nice graphics, like being able to see the pores in the skin and really badly softened graphics, like they just ran out of money and needed to throw stuff in to fill the gaps. Game actions are very repetitive and some things are stupid, like if you place a turret, then pick up a missile launcher, your turret will explode for no reason. This should only be an ALPHA phase of the game. Not quite a BETA phase yet and definitely not a finished product. If you are excited to play a Star Wars game, like I was, prepare to be quite disappointed. You need to be a real Star Wars fan to get any pleasure out of putting yourself through the torment of mistakes made throughout Star Wars Battlefront 2. I have games on my phone that have better flight controls. In fact, ALL the flight games on my phone have a better flight control system, and it's a phone!

Campaign is worth $7. Another $3 for the extended campaign. Multiplayer is dead / empty.

Honest opinion, get it for less than $10 and you won't be too disappointed. Should really be free to play.

These problems need to be addressed by the developer, even though the game is a bit old. The mechanics and visuals are great, however those few players were able to ruin my entire night. May the force be with you.

The BEST Star Wars game ever made. The default experience is already fantastic, but mods take this game to another level. Practically any Star Wars era, trooper, hero, or battle you can think of is available. If you're into sandbox combat and want to create your own Star Wars battles, this is easily one of the greats.

This game is the best for Star Wars fans. The large scale battles are fun and you can play for HOURS. No stupid loot boxes and no pay to win. You unlock better skills and upgrades by leveling up and simply just playing the game.

This game is amazing. It's Star Wars. It delivers lots of action and fun for any age. The campaign is solid and shows character development and good detail. The multiplayer offers lots of grinding options so you don't get bored. Basically Star Wars battlefield lmao. Only downside is that the game isn't too alive. For the supremacy gamemode, you can pretty much only search for Age of Republic, and the other options just dont have many players playing it. Other than that, other game modes like Heroes vs Villains is great and fills your nostalgia.

Late 2021. Cheating is rampant, I often have to waste 20 minutes trying to find a game without blatant cheating. And I'm not talking about players using "usual" hacks either, I'm talking about entire matches and game modes ruined because of an 1 HP exploit, meaning no one can die or kill anyone. EA is slow to respond and the whole situation is a mess.

Add to that the fact that the single player modes are very limited and it becomes really difficult to recommend this game for either shooter or SW fans.

Seems fun but one day in and hackers are allegedly hacking the Supremacy lobby. No one has been able to play all day. And there's absolutely no method of reporting this. Neither as a bug nor as abuse.

This one is a tough one.

On one hand, the game looks stunning, the sounds and voice acting are incredible and I really do like all the different characters in the game and customization options. The core game play loop is just as fun as it was back in the glory days of the original battle front and I could see my self sinking just as much time into this one as the old ones.

HOWEVER. I just cannot forgive the lack of features on the single player side of things. Basically my negative review comes down to a missing single player game mode, Galactic Conquest. I just cannot get my head around why this mode would be left out. I wouldn't even need anything crazy innovative. Just give me an exact copy of the galactic conquest in BF2. I'd even take BF1's galactic conquest mode. Its very sad and severely hurts my replay ability. Sure I can just play random maps solo but its just not the same.

I understand that this likely means nothing to people who don't care about single player but for me its a massive negative and thus results in a negative review. If you are someone like me who mostly wants a solo experience vs the ai wait till its on sale. Probably like $10 or less.
Fuck EA, I actually like the game but I can't even log into EA's godamn launcher. I love owning nothing !!!
I really love this game, obviously by my playtime. There are good things and bad things about the game, I wouldn't pay full price for it but if it's on sale I would completely recommend buying.

reason.text: Negative reviews from this period focus on a 1 HP bug that stops players from being killed, which reviews describe as making online multiplayer unplayable.
Reviews also point to hackers on servers and say the problem has not been fixed.

lines.F1: STAR WARS Battlefront II had a score drop (the monthly score fell well below its usual level), Dec 2021 to Jan 2022
lines.F2: Dec 2021: 66% positive across 794 reviews (273 negative), against a usual 88% positive and 62 negative a month
lines.F3: Jan 2022: 59% positive across 824 reviews (337 negative), against a usual 86% positive and 74 negative a month
lines.R1: (negative review, 345h played) "a frequent 1hp bug crippling the online gaming been like months, and they don't bother to fix it."
lines.R5: (negative review, 44h played) "Multiplayer is basically dead due to a 1hp hack, where no one can die. Single-Player story is pretty good, but not worth the price"
lines.R6: (negative review, 371h played) "Does not get updated and is currently unplayable because of a hack. Stay clear of this one. I love to kill time with this game but it is actually unplayable and it seems EA is not going to fix the issue"
lines.R7: (negative review, 55h played) "This game has gone from playable to unbearable. Multiplayer is inaccessible often for multiple days at a time due to the sheer number of hackers that set server settings to 1 HP where no players can die. This is often applied to every active server,..."
lines.R8: (negative review, 386h played) "WARNING ! ! ! The Online gaming mode is heavily hit by a glitch making it mainly impossible to play: both Players and AI reaching 1hp but not being defeated. If you are interested in playing the online mode DO NOT BUY THIS GAME now. Wait untill EA..."
lines.R13: (negative review, 140h played) "I'll recommend this game when EA fixes their cheating issues. Fix the 1 HP glitch. Do not buy this game until this problem is solved."
lines.R14: (negative review, 1270h played) "The Game is broken online. Hackers everywhere and lobbies are unplayable. Teams can't score at all due to 1hp bug. The price that steam is asking is for is theft."

tldr.text: Very Positive (87%): players praise the co-op and the story.
Common complaints include cheaters, bugs and crashes.

details.text: Players with a short playtime are far less positive, at 51% positive, than those who stick with it.
Only 6% of recent reviews complain about bugs and crashes, down from 12% of all reviews.
